checked.how: src/content/tracks.ts sorts glob keys by path: bends < dust-bowl < hay-loop, so TRACKS[0] is bends, nextTrackId('dust-bowl') is 'hay-loop', and (i+1)%3 wraps hay-loop to bends. hay-loop.json has id 'hay-loop', name 'Hay Loop', laps 3, width 11, and validateTrack accepts it (gates G1 pass).

Summed the control-polygon distances: about 1172 units, inside 1000–1400. The tip (264,15.6)→(273,0)→(264,-15.6) turns about 180° over about 55 units, so 150° fits in 50 units. The arch at x −43..126 turns left, then right within 120 units. tests/content/hay-loop.test.ts AC2 passes in G1.

checked.target: AC3 ramp lip and back straight
checked.how: track.ts:201 and :339 put the lip at sampleAt(at*length), so the lip is at 0.63, about 738 units. That lies between (110,-58) and (60,-58), on the straight bottom leg (the back straight) and inside 35–65%. There is exactly one ramp.

checked.target: AC6 side convention for hairpin rows
checked.how: track.ts:348-355: right offset = (cos h, sin h). Going east on the top leg, right is +z, which is outward, and the loop is consistently oriented. Hay bales on the left are inside and tyres on the right outside at 0.41–0.48 (about 480–562 units), covering the tip at about 527. The mid-race screenshot agrees.

The cone-tree propRows are all side 'right', which is outside, so the infield trees are the 22 explicit props (z −36..84). Most lie inside the polygon, more than 6.5 units from the centreline (e.g. (245,0) is 14.7 from both hairpin legs). The scene-test counts come from the same layout.props.

gates.md G2: hay-loop bot lap 50.61 s, inside 48–56. G1 runs 622/622 tests, including hay-loop-bot.test.ts (5 single-bot seeds, six-car seeds 1–5 with a five-minute cap) and the every-track bot/six-car suites.

checked.target: Playtest steps 1–3 (RACE → Bends, NEXT RACE → Dust Bowl → Hay Loop)
checked.how: game.ts:123 sets menuTrack = TRACKS[0] (bends), :136 RACE uses menuTrack.id, and :108 NEXT RACE uses nextTrackId(race.track.id). Screenshot 844x390/race/hay-loop-finished.png shows 'HAY LOOP' on the results screen.

checked.target: Playtest step 5 (minimap shows the whole loop)
checked.how: hud.ts:95-111 fits the outline bounding box with min(scaleW, scaleH) and centres it, so the roughly 507×170 track fits. The mid-race screenshot minimap shows the full loop with the teardrop end.
